coverage.assessment: Several hinges are lost: the glacial heresy motive and the transition into Terebratula, the reason the wolf question is excluded, the publish dilemma, the 'what better could he have done' frame, and the New York daily ambition. The Pendennis joke loses its timing.
With Palgrave/Tennyson dropped, 'neither of them' refers to Darwin and Lyell. That contradicts Lyell's visits to the Legation. Other referents (Milnes Gaskells, Siluria, Quincy Bay) are grounded.

There is no direct dialogue. The reported exchanges with Lyell keep their order: offer, assent, the inserted Agassiz sentence, silence, Terebratula, the first vertebrate. The quoted Agassiz sentence and the La Fontaine verse are intact.

'Before Pteraspis was eternal void' loses its immediate qualification (shell-fish and trilobites) and now clashes with paragraph 7. 'Precisely what this rank was worth, no one could say' is also gone. The price figures match.
The 'path ultimately led' retrospect survives. Other dual-perspective ironies are cut: losing his hold on results, the Oxford-degree verdict, 'thirty years to wait'.
The Wenlock meditation is reduced to two parallels before 'The triumph of all'. The Welsh-thief self-deprecation and the 1867 Shropshire frame are lost, which is the risk the plan names.
'No Faith' loses its foil in other Darwinians' religious hope. That foil linked the 'substitute for religion' theme to the confession.
All three dependencies hold at both endpoints. The 018 New York daily ambition was an unplanned setup that has now been cut (see F8).

findings.claim: The source compares Lyell's promise about Darwin with Palgrave's about Tennyson, so 'neither of them' means Darwin and Tennyson. With Palgrave dropped, the only pair left is Darwin and Lyell. The text thus asserts that Lyell never came to town, yet two paragraphs later he calls at the Legation.
findings.counterevidence: Readers may infer that 'them' means Darwin and some unnamed figure, but no such second person is present.

findings.claim: The revision cuts two motives. One is that Adams thought Lyell's glacial guesses proof of nothing yet was forced to state them, which is why he inserted a provocative sentence. The other is the bridge 'uniformity often worked queerly', which led him to ask for the simplest case. As a result, 'hinted his heresies' follows a single question, and the Terebratula inquiry starts with no connective.

findings.claim: The source excludes the wolf question for two reasons: no complete proof of Natural Selection reached back to Pteraspis, and before Pteraspis was void. It then qualifies the void as lacking only vertebrates, with shell-fish and trilobites present. The revision keeps only 'for before Pteraspis was eternal void'. This weakens the 'for' logic and contradicts paragraph 7's 'a few shell-fish'. It also drops the trilobite and Quincy Bay bathing memory that prepares the horseshoe.

strengths: All eight verbatim anchors survive intact, including the French poodle image, V6's triple paradox, and 'He was a Darwinian for fun.'
Continuity glosses are handled economically: the Abbey is 'the home of his English friends the Milnes Gaskells', Pocahontas becomes 'his earlier historical article', and Ara Coeli is dated to 1860.
The price chain holds: 'five or ten thousand million dollars and a million lives' set against 'five thousand millions more... a million more lives', with the 'path ultimately led' retrospect kept.
The revision restores the 'Limulus ancestry... their thought was one' passage that the first draft had dropped, strengthening the Wenlock confession.
summary: The revision meets length and continuity targets. It keeps all verbatim anchors, glosses the Milnes Gaskells and the Pocahontas article, dates Ara Coeli to 1860, and preserves all three dependencies. One referent error inherited from the first draft remains: 'neither of them ever came to town' now covers Lyell, who later visits the Legation. The revision's cuts also removed several logical hinges and retrospective ironies: the glacial-heresy setup, the qualification on the 'void', the Darwinism-as-religion foil, the 1867 contemporaries frame, the New York daily setup, and the reason the last year was pleasantest. The tail sections are under their planned weight, so there is room for small restorations.
